name: BiscottiCMP
summary: Unpublished iOS consent-management release candidate with release-gated TCF 2.4 preparation.
description:
Biscotti CMP iOS SDK release candidate: native consent dialog, consent-gated
SDK initialisation, App Tracking Transparency coordination, offline queueing
and consent sync. Native TCF publication remains blocked until a separate
Native App (Mobile) registration and release gate are complete.
